= Description Lists

A description item has a term and a definition.

The delimiter is a double colon:

term:: The definition can be on the same line.
another term:: A term can contain spaces.

The delimiter is the first `::` followed by a space.

This lets a term contain colons:

`:date:`:: An attribute name with colons.
`_media/`:: A directory name that starts with an underscore.

A definition can contain inline formatting.

A definition can also continue on later lines, like a list item:

soft-wrapped:: This definition continues on a second line. The next line is
  indented for alignment. The indentation is not content.
formatted:: Definitions can contain *bold*, _italic_, `monospace`, and
  link:https://example.org/[links].

A term can appear with no definition on the same line:

standalone::
  The definition starts here.

A block image is not a description item.

The image target starts immediately after `::`, with no following space:

image::diagram.png[A diagram]
